seoTitle: Case Converter for Text and Headlines
metaDescription: Change text to uppercase, lowercase, title case or sentence case in your browser.
intro: Change text to uppercase, lowercase, title case or sentence case in your browser.
aboutTitle: Which text cases can I convert between?
about: Case Converter changes capitalization while keeping your text in the editor. Choose a standard case for headings and prose, or use alternating and inverse case for stylized text.
example: Paste “THE WEEKLY SEO REPORT” and choose Sentence case to get “The weekly seo report”. Review acronyms such as SEO before copying.

faqs.question: Can I reverse a conversion?
faqs.answer: Use Undo to recover your previous text after a conversion.
